journal.restless.form.whole: Takes it whole: an iron ingot, glowstone, holy water, a mirror.
journal.restless.form.bit: Takes a bit: an iron nugget, glowstone dust, salt, a glass pane.
journal.restless.form.crafted: Takes it crafted: an iron chain, a lantern, a bell, a spyglass.
journal.restless.bestiary.poltergeist: Loud and restless. Doors, chests, things moving on their own. Hardly dangerous at first.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade: Quiet. Puts out lights, whispers, wears you down. Gets crueler over time.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade.name: Shade
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom: Wants to pass for a living person: a stranger far off, a name that isn't there. Rarely hurts anyone.
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom.name: Phantom
journal.restless.bestiary.nix: Stays near water. Holds swimmers under, calls you toward the shore, breaks boats.
journal.restless.bestiary.nix.name: Nix
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic: Fakes things: blocks that aren't there, strangers, animals that vanish.
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic.name: Mimic
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith: Hunts in the dark. Puts your light out first, then comes closer.
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith.name: Wraith
journal.restless.bestiary.mara: Sits on sleepers. Worse at night, worst of all in a bed.
journal.restless.bestiary.mara.name: Mara
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee: Mostly a voice. Makes noise and barely touches anything.
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee.name: Banshee
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant: Out for revenge. Hurts you, sends animals after you, remembers every kill.
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant.name: Revenant
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one: Wanders. Shapes, footsteps, strangers. Follows you underground.
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one.name: Lost one
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi: Lives in a house. Doors, belongings, noises around the place. Mostly harmless.
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi.name: Domovoi
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder: Stays in one place and takes whatever you leave lying there.
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder.name: Hoarder
journal.restless.bestiary.demon: Stays in one place and is dangerous: hits you, makes you sick, sends animals.
journal.restless.bestiary.demon.name: Demon
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster: Stays in one place and plays tricks: changes blocks and items, shows you things that aren't there.
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster.name: Trickster
journal.restless.guide.start.title: Read this first
journal.restless.guide.start.1: The dead here don't rest. Some attach themselves to a living person and follow them around. Others stay in one place.
journal.restless.guide.start.2: They start out weak and get stronger the longer they're left alone. I learned that the hard way. Some pages are blank because I never worked those out.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.title: Signs
journal.restless.guide.haunted.1: Doors slam on their own, torches go out, steps sound where nobody is walking. That's a spirit, and it won't stop by itself.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.2: A spirit candle leans toward whoever the spirit goes for next, and burns blue just before. A spirit compass points at the nearest one. A closed ring of salt keeps them out. I tested it.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.3: Only tools tell you which one it is: ash for prints, a camera obscura for photos, a spirit box, an ouija board. Each one shows only part of it.
journal.restless.guide.clues.title: Telling them apart
journal.restless.guide.clues.1: Every spirit has its own habits, and one clue shows only one of them. I never decided until I had a few.
journal.restless.guide.clues.2: Photos and ash prints are always true. The spirit box and the board sometimes lie.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.title: The altar
journal.restless.guide.weakness.1: Every spirit has a nature, one of four: iron, glowstone, holy water or mirror. Nearly all its habits come from it, and exactly one is foreign. Two different habits of one nature name it.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.2: Iron: reaches for things, slams doors, goes through chests. Glowstone: eats light, chills the air, walks at night, dwells in the dark. Holy water: takes revenge, walks in the rain, calls from the deep, forgives nothing. Mirror: whispers, feeds on noise, steals sleep, lies.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.3: Ash does not lie. A paw means iron, a drag mark glowstone, a hoof holy water, a bare foot mirror. A foreign habit leaves a foreign print, so I go by the print I see most.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.4: A nature is not enough: the spirit does not take every item of it. The bestiary card, once I have a photo, says which: whole, a bit, or crafted. I built an altar, lit four candles, closed a ring of salt and laid the right thing down. A form it does not take, it puts up with, but the ritual drags on.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.5: It fights back: snuffs the candles and hits, and I relit them. The wrong nature costs more: every candle goes out, the spirit rages, hides for a day and turns the altar away, and it comes of age sooner.
journal.restless.guide.graves.title: Graves
journal.restless.guide.graves.1: Every spirit used to be someone. The grave turned up a few hundred blocks from home, and the stone says who they were and what they lost.
journal.restless.guide.graves.2: Once I brought that back, they rested. It worked better than any ritual. When my head was going, the spirit box told me where the bones were.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.title: Your head
journal.restless.guide.sanity.1: Darkness, cursed ground and every scare wore me down. Light, food, sleep and salt brought me back.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.2: The worse shape I was in, the more the spirit box picked up.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.title: Left alone
journal.restless.guide.evolution.1: A spirit left alone long enough turns into something worse, and it doesn't turn back. The ground around some of them goes grey.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.2: Once it's banished or at rest, the ground recovers.
journal.restless.guide.essence.title: Essence
journal.restless.guide.essence.1: Some spirits leave essence behind. A ritual gave one. A grave put right gave more.
journal.restless.guide.essence.2: Charms can be made from it. Poltergeist essence pulls dropped items in, shade essence lets you see in the dark.
restless.relighting.title: Relighting
restless.relighting.description: Right-click the placed light with flint and steel or a lit torch. Flint and steel loses 1 durability; torches are not consumed. Cannot ignite underwater.
message.restless.holy_water_cloudy: The water has gone cloudy. It is useless until dawn.
